source: Instituto Electoral de la Ciudad de México (IECM), 'Colonias de la Ciudad de México' 2019 (coloniascdmx, datos.cdmx.gob.mx; copy from library.metabolismofcities.org item 36759, downloaded 2026-10-30), 1,812 colonias joined into 1,504 names (numbered parts such as ROMA NORTE I-III merged; housing-unit, pueblo and barrio tags dropped; the accents and Ñ the file lost restored), simplified to about 20 m with 4-decimal coordinates (the Worker bundles this file about five times). Then the 16 alcaldías from Who's On First (Quattroshapes, ~30 m), the same outlines as config/metro-bounds/mexico-city.json, as the fallback where no colonia holds a point (the smallest outline wins). Chosen over WOF's colonias, which put half of six known venues in the wrong one (D-440).
